searchText: Hi folks. What’s going to happen to geth running alone after the merge? Is it mandatory to manage both of eth1 and eth2 clients even when only execution layer is one’s concern? Yes, you need to run both a cl and an el client Thanks Is "The Merge" on already on any testnet or clients devs are still working on it? I was wondering if there is already any merge-ready client out there 🙂 Yes, check this out: https://pithos.consensus-monitor.stokes.io/ Geth is "merge-ready" with 4 out of 5 cl clients (though the code is highly WIP) ok, does `consensus_finalise_block` actually do anything? in the rayonism spec it says that it is unsure what you can do with it which left me wondering wheter it is actually necessary it also says that it just can return true all the time Do you mean ConsensusValidated? Most of the methods got renamed since rayonism is there a new spec document i can look at? https://hackmd.io/@n0ble/merge-interop-spec https://hackmd.io/@tvanepps/amphora-milestones all clients added some documentation about their milestones here i see... but is there any specification for the engine_ API then? i just see a 4 lines paragraph talking about it https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/v1.0.0-alpha.2/src/engine/interop/specification.md It was linked in the beginning (had to search for it myself a bit :D) thank you! really helpful. I ask this because I am working forward to make Erigon "merge"-ready, i will come up with any questions if i have any after will be finished reading it

excerpts.author: kamadd
excerpts.content: Hi folks. What’s going to happen to geth running alone after the merge? Is it mandatory to manage both of eth1 and eth2 clients even when only execution layer is one’s concern?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yes, you need to run both a cl and an el client

excerpts.author: kamadd
excerpts.content: Thanks

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: Is "The Merge" on already on any testnet or clients devs are still working on it?

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: I was wondering if there is already any merge-ready client out there 🙂

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yes, check this out: https://pithos.consensus-monitor.stokes.io/ Geth is "merge-ready" with 4 out of 5 cl clients (though the code is highly WIP)
